recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray #F2F2F2.
2. Draw a thin red (#CC0000) rectangle border framing the entire slide edge (no fill).
3. Place the title 'Calculation of Model Parameter “W”' centered at the top, spanning roughly the top 5-15% of slide height, in bold sans-serif red #CC0000, with the letter W inside the curly quotes colored blue #0000CC.
4. Place a yellow (#FFFF99) filled circle in the top-right corner with the black number 19 centered inside it.
5. Draw the upper equation box: a red-bordered (#CC0000) rectangle at left-center spanning x ~10-60% and y ~20-55% of the slide (fill not specified; leave transparent).
6. Inside the upper box, place the equation 'Y = X W' as the first line in large bold text: Y underlined in black, X in blue #0000CC, W underlined in red #CC0000.
7. Inside the upper box below the equation, place the line 'Where: X_{N x d+1} is a matrix' with the subscript 'N x d+1' in blue #0000CC, followed by a red (#CC0000) double arrow ⇒ and the bold black word 'Given'.
8. Below step 7's line, place 'Y_{N x 1} is labels vector' with the subscript 'N x 1' in blue #0000CC, followed by a red ⇒ and bold black 'Given'.
9. Below step 8's line, place 'W is Model Parameter' followed by a red ⇒ and bold black 'Required'.
10. Draw a large hollow right-pointing block arrow between the two upper boxes, spanning x ~60-68% and y ~35-45% of the slide, with outline #CC6666 and fill #FFFFFF.
11. Draw the result box: a smaller red-bordered (#CC0000) rectangle at right-center spanning x ~68-92% and y ~33-48% of the slide (fill not specified; leave transparent).
12. Inside the result box, place the equation 'W = X^{-1} Y' in large bold text: W underlined in black, X^{-1} in blue #0000CC, Y underlined in red #CC0000.
13. Inside the result box, place a yellow (#FFD700) smiley face emoji to the right of the equation.
14. Draw the lower equation box: a red-bordered (#CC0000) rectangle at bottom-left spanning x ~10-50% and y ~60-92% of the slide (fill not specified; leave transparent).
15. Inside the lower box, place the equation 'W = (X_{N x d})^{-1} Y' in large bold text: W underlined, X and the parentheses in blue #0000CC, Y underlined in red #CC0000.
16. Below that equation, place the line 'X_{N x d} is non-square matrix' in black with the subscript 'N x d' in blue #0000CC.
17. Below that line, place 'There is NO Inverse' in bold italic red #CC0000 with NO in capitals.
18. At the right side of the lower box, place a yellow (#FFD700) sad/frowning face emoji.
